name: twilio-docs-mcp
description: Search Twilio’s APIs and build customer engagement experiences directly from Claude. Across more than 1,800 endpoints, Twilio MCP surfaces the exact specs and code patterns you need for channels like voice, email, and SMS/RCS, as well as user identity, customer data, contact center, and conversational AI. Get straight to the right API details and implementation guidance without loading full API docs into context or leaving your IDE.

tool.name: twilio__retrieve
tool.description: Fetch full parameter schemas and response details for one or more Twilio API operations or documentation articles. Use this after twilio__search to get the complete request body fields, path/query parameters, response schema, and curator guidance needed to actually call the API. Pass the id values exactly as returned by twilio__search.

ids.description: One or more id values (format: 'op::{api}::{operation_id}') copied verbatim from twilio__search results — do not construct or guess IDs. Only call this tool after calling twilio__search and receiving results. Pass multiple ids to batch-fetch related operations in one call.

fields.description: Optional. Limit which top-level fields are returned for each result to reduce payload size. Omit to receive the full spec. For API operations, 'request_body' returns request parameters and body schema; 'response_fields' returns the response schema. Identity fields (api, method, path, operation_id) are always included. All other fields — including intent, summary, description, product, version, and response_schema — are excluded when fields is set. Use twilio__search first to get intent and summary; only use fields here when you need the raw parameter or response schema.

tool.name: twilio__search
tool.description: Search Twilio documentation and API operations by natural language query. Use source="docs" for conceptual guides and setup questions, source="api" for finding specific API endpoints and operations, or source="all" (default) when unsure. Returns ranked documentation snippets and/or API operation summaries. Use twilio__retrieve with an id from API results to get full parameter schemas.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 5, max 10. Increase only when you need broader coverage.

query.description: Natural language question or description of what you want to do. Be specific — 'how to set up ConversationRelay' or 'send an SMS message' work better than 'relay' or 'messaging'.

source.description: Use "docs" for conceptual guides, tutorials, and setup questions. Use "api" for finding specific API endpoints, operations, and parameters — preferred for coding tasks. Use "all" when unsure (default). "all" fires both searches in parallel and interleaves results by rank.

topics.description:
Optional. Restrict doc search to specific sources. Omit to search twilio_docs (default) when you don't know. Only applies when source="docs" or source="all".
- twilio_docs: API references, error codes, TwiML, SDK docs, tutorials (twilio.com/docs)
- support_docs: troubleshooting and account support (help.twilio.com)
- twilio_com: Twilio marketing and product pages
- twilio_customers: customer stories and case studies
- twilio_org: Twilio.org social impact content
- sendgrid: SendGrid product documentation
- sendgrid_support: SendGrid support articles
- segment: Segment CDP documentation

product.description: Optional. Restrict API results to a specific Twilio product. Only applies when source="api" or source="all". Use "api_v2010" for the core Twilio communications REST API (calls, SMS/MMS, phone numbers, conferences, recordings).

version.description: Optional. Omit for latest version only, "any" for any version, or a specific version e.g. "v2". Requires product to also be set when pinning to a specific version.

_published_faq.name: How do I add twilio-docs-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add twilio-docs-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.twilio.com/docs.

_published_faq.name: Is twilio-docs-mcp MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, twilio-docs-mcp scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is twilio-docs-mcp's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, twilio-docs-mcp scores 65/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the twilio-docs-mcp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: twilio-docs-mcp provides these MCP tools: twilio__search and twilio__retrieve.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to twilio-docs-mcp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to twilio-docs-mcp in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
twilio-docs-mcp does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can twilio-docs-mcp improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: twilio__retrieve is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 63/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
twilio-docs-mcp is developed by Twilio. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
